raw_segments.text: And these are not the only evils, I said—there are several lesser ones. In such a state of society the master fears and flatters his scholars, and the scholars despise their masters and tutors. Young and old are all alike. And the young man is on a level with the old, and is ready to compete with him in word or deed, and old men condescend to the young and are full of pleasantry and gaiety. They are loth to be thought morose and authoritative, and therefore they adopt the manners of the young.
